Draw human blood

name: violence_hgibs
description:
Default: true
Show human gib entities

name: vis_enable
description:
Default: true
Enable precomputed visibility when true

name: vis_sunlight_enable
description:
Default: true
Toggle whether to use sunlight PVS for sunlight views (0 = sky PVS, 1 = sunlight PVS)

name: voice_all_icons
description:
Default: false
Draw all players' voice icons

name: voice_always_sample_mic
description:
Default: false
When enabled, open the voip audio input stream when the application launches.

name: voice_input_stallout
description:
Default: 2
Time before we consider a mic stalled out and need to reset it.

name: voice_modenable
description:
Default: true
Enable/disable voice in this mod.

name: voice_sequence_maximum_wait_time
description:
Default: 0.5
When receiving packets out of sequence, wait this many seconds for missing sequences to arrive

name: voice_threshold
description:
Default: -120
decibel threshold for how loud the talker's input signal is before we think they are talking.

name: voice_threshold_attack
description:
Default: 0.3
Amount of time we buffer outgoing audio to detect an onset.

name: voice_threshold_delay
description:
Default: 0.7
Amount of time the talker is silent before we infer that they are no longer talking.

name: voice_threshold_hold
description:
Default: 0.2
Amount of time after the talker starts talking we should keep listening regardless of how loud they are speaking.

name: voice_threshold_ramp_min_db
description:
Default: -60
A dB floor of when to stop transmitting packets, the volume between this and voice_threshold will still transmit packets to allow for volume ramping.

name: voice_vox
description:
Default: 0
Voice chat uses a vox-style always on

name: voice_vox_current_peak
description:
Default: 0
Current peak value (out of 64k) of the incoming voice stream

Sound volume

Scale global volume fog density

name: volume_fog_shadow_penumbra_multiplier

Penumbra size multiplier for shadow sampling, reduces fog shadow aliasing

name: volume_fog_temporal_weight
description:

Temporal filtering weight

Change global friction factor

name: vphys2_restitution_factor

Change global restitution factor

name: vprof_scope_entity_clientthink

Disable weapon inaccuracy spread

name: weapon_accuracy_reset_on_deploy

On deploy, forcibly reset weapon accuracy to zero.

name: weapon_air_spread_scale

Scale factor for jumping inaccuracy, set to 0 to make jumping accuracy equal to standing

name: weapon_auto_cleanup_time

If set to non-zero, weapons will delete themselves after the specified time (in seconds) if no players are near.

name: weapon_debug_inaccuracy_only_up
description:
Default: false
Force weapon inaccuracy to be in exactly the up direction

name: weapon_debug_max_inaccuracy

Force all shots to have maximum inaccuracy

name: weapon_debug_spread_show

Enables display of weapon accuracy; 1: show accuracy box, 3: show accuracy with dynamic crosshair

name: weapon_land_dip_amt
description:
Default: 20
The amount the gun should dip when the player lands after a jump.

name: weapon_max_before_cleanup
description:
Default: 0
If set to non-zero, will remove the oldest dropped weapon to maintegerain the specified number of dropped weapons in the world.

name: weapon_molotov_maxdetonateslope
description:
Default: 30
Maximum angle of slope on which the molotov will detonate

name: weapon_reticle_knife_show

When enabled will show knife reticle on clients. Used for game modes requiring target id display when holding a knife.

name: weapon_sound_falloff_multiplier
description:
Default: 1
Scaling for falloff of weapon firing sounds

name: webapi_values_init_buffer_size
description:
Default: 65536
Initial buffer size for buffers in the WebAPIValues buffer pool

name: webapi_values_max_pool_size_mb
description:
Default: 400
Maximum size in bytes of the WebAPIValues buffer pool

name: zoom_sensitivity_ratio
description:
Default: 1
Additional mouse sensitivity scale factor applied when FOV is zoomed in.

name: matchzy_knife_enabled_default
description:
Whether knife round is enabled by default or not. This is the default value, but knife can be toggled by [admins](#creating-admins) using .roundknife command.
**`Default: true`**

name: matchzy_minimum_ready_required
description:
Minimum ready players required to start the match. If set to 0, all connected players have to ready-up to start the match.
**`Default: 2`**

name: matchzy_stop_command_available
description:
Whether !stop/.stop command to restore the backup of the current round is enabled by default or not.
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_stop_command_no_damage
description:
Whether the stop command becomes unavailable if a player damages a player from the opposing team.
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_pause_after_restore
description:
Whether to pause the match after round restore or not. Players can unpause the match using !unpause/.unpause. (Both the teams will have to use unpause command) or admins can use `.fup` to force-unpause the game
**`Default: true`**

name: matchzy_whitelist_enabled_default
description:
Whether [whitelist](#whitelisting-players) is enabled by default or not. This is the default value, but whitelist can be toggled by admin using ``.whitelist`` command
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_kick_when_no_match_loaded
description:
Whether to kick all clients and prevent anyone from joining the server if no match is loaded. This means if server is in match mode, a match needs to be set-up using `matchzy_loadmatch`/`matchzy_loadmatch_url` to load and configure a match.
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_demo_path
description:
Path of folder in which demos will be saved. If defined, it must not start with a slash and must end with a slash. Set to empty string to use the csgo root. Example: `matchzy_demo_path MatchZy/`
**`Default: MatchZy/`**

name: matchzy_demo_name_format
description:
Format of demo filname. You may use {TIME}, {MATCH_ID}, {MAP}, {MAPNUMBER}, {TEAM1} and {TEAM2}. Demo files will be named according to the format specified. Do not include .dem format, it will be added automatically. Make sure to keep {TIME} in the format to create a unique demo file everytime.
**`Default: "{TIME}_{MATCH_ID}_{MAP}_{TEAM1}_vs_{TEAM2}"`**

name: matchzy_demo_upload_url
description:
If defined, recorded demo will be [uploaded](../gotv#automatic-upload) to this URL once the map ends. Make sure that the URL is wrapped in double quotes (""). Example: `matchzy_demo_upload_url "https://your-website.com/upload-endpointeger"`
**`Default: ""`**

name: matchzy_chat_prefix
description:
Chat prefix to show whenever a MatchZy message is sent to players. Available Colors: {Default}, {Darkred}, {Green}, {LightYellow}, {LightBlue}, {Olive}, {Lime}, {Red}, {Purple}, {Grey}, {Yellow}, {Gold}, {Silver}, {Blue}, {DarkBlue}, {BlueGrey}, {Magenta} and {LightRed}. Make sure to end your prefix with {Default} to avoid coloring the messages in your prefix color.
**`Default: [{Green}MatchZy{Default}]`**

name: matchzy_admin_chat_prefix
description:
Chat prefix to show whenever an admin sends message using `.asay `. Avaiable Colors are mentioned above.
**`Default: [{Red}ADMIN{Default}]`**

name: matchzy_chat_messages_timer_delay
description:
Number of seconds of delay before sending reminder messages from MatchZy (like unready message, paused message, etc). Note: Changing this timer wont affect the active timer, so if you change this setting in warmup, you will have to restart warmup to make the change effective.
**`Default: 13`**

name: matchzy_playout_enabled_default
description:
Whether playout (play max rounds) is enabled. This is the default value, but playout can be toggled by admin using `.playout` command.
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_reset_cvars_on_series_end
description:
Whether parameters from the cvars section of a match configuration are restored to their original values when a series ends.
**`Default: true`**

name: matchzy_use_pause_command_for_tactical_pause
description:
Whether to use !pause/.pause command for tactical pause or normal pause (unpauses only when both teams use unpause command, for admin force-unpauses the game).
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_autostart_mode
description:
Whether the plugin will load the match mode, the practice moder or neither by startup. 0 for neither, 1 for match mode, 2 for practice mode.
**`Default: 1`**

name: matchzy_save_nades_as_global_enabled
description:
Whether nades should be saved globally instead of being privated to players by default or not.
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_allow_force_ready
description:
Whether force ready using !forceready is enabled or not (Currently works in Match Setup only).
**`Default: true`**

name: matchzy_max_saved_last_grenades
description:
Maximum number of grenade history that may be saved per-map, per-client. Set to 0 to disable the limit and allow unlimited grenades to be stored.
**`Default: 512`**

name: matchzy_smoke_color_enabled
description:
If enabled, the smoke's color will be changed to player's team color (player's color seen in the radar) .
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_everyone_is_admin
description:
If set to true, everyone will be granted admin permissions for MatchZy.
**`Default: false`**

name: matchzy_show_credits_on_match_start
description:
Whether to show 'MatchZy Plugin by WD-' message on match start.
**`Default: true`**

name: matchzy_hostname_format
description:
The server hostname to use. Set to "" to disable/use existing. Available variables: {TIME}, {MATCH_ID}, {MAP}, {MAPNUMBER}, {TEAM1}, {TEAM2}, {TEAM1_SCORE}, {TEAM2_SCORE}
**`Default: MatchZy | {TEAM1} vs {TEAM2}`**

name: matchzy_match_start_message
description:
Message to show when the match starts. Use $$$ to break message integero multiple lines. Set to "" to disable. Available Colors: {Default}, {Darkred}, {Green}, {LightYellow}, {LightBlue}, {Olive}, {Lime}, {Red}, {Purple}, {Grey}, {Yellow}, {Gold}, {Silver}, {Blue}, {DarkBlue}. Example usage: matchzy_match_start_message {Green} Welcome to the server! {Default} $$$ Agent models are not allowed and may lead to {Red}disqualification!{Default}
**`Default: ""`**

name: matchzy_enable_damage_report
description: Whether to show damage report after each round or not. **`Default: "true"`**

name: matchzy_remote_log_url
description:
The URL to send all [events](../events_and_forwards) to (POST request). Set to empty string to disable. [OpenAPI Doc for the events](events.html)
**`Default: ""`**
Usage: `matchzy_remote_log_url "url"`
Alias: `get5_remote_log_url`

name: matchzy_remote_log_header_key
description:
If this and matchzy_remote_log_header_value are defined, this header name and value will be added in your [HTTP Post requests'](../events_and_forwards) header.
**`Default: ""`**
Usage: `matchzy_remote_log_header_key "Authorization"`
Alias: `get5_remote_log_header_key`

name: matchzy_remote_log_header_value
description:
If this and matchzy_remote_log_header_key are defined, this header name and value will be added in your [HTTP Post requests'](../events_and_forwards) header.
**`Default: ""`**
Usage: `matchzy_remote_log_header_value "header_value"`
Alias: `get5_remote_log_header_value`
